Basically, what the bureaus ar saying is that ANYONE can report anything on a consumer 's credit file without any proof they owe it. Only items in which I ever agreed to pay or owe the debt are allowed to report on my credit file and the burden is on the bureaus and not on me. ( see XXXX v TRANSUNION 1997 ).
